title: trifolium resupinatum subsp. clusii
intro: Trifolium resupinatum subsp. clusii, commonly known as Clustered Clover, is a plant species belonging to the family Fabaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in reducing stress and promoting overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Trifolium resupinatum subsp. clusii include its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
